data.raw_text:
United Airlines flight 32 has been evacuated at Kansai Airport following an emergency landing.

All passengers escaped, and according to the fire department, two people were slightly injured.

According to the operating company of Kansai Airport and the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism, after 7 p.m. on the 12th, United Airlines Flight 32, which was heading to Cebu, Philippines, made an emergency landing at Kansai Airport.

A message indicating that a fire broke out in the cargo compartment was displayed in the cockpit, and after stopping for a while on the taxiway, the passengers evacuated at around 7:30 p.m.

data.raw_text:
LOOK: Students, faculty, and staff of the University of the Philippines staged a walkout from their classes and offices on Friday, Sept. 12, 2025, to demand transparency and accountability in light of revelations about massive corruption in the country’s flood control and other infrastructure projects.

In UP Diliman, black shirts and protest banners filled the steps of Palma Hall as streams of marchers from across the campus converged on the historic protest site. The university-wide walkout was endorsed by UP Diliman Chancellor Edgardo Carlo Vistan II.

UP Manila and UP Tacloban College also held simultaneous walkouts, with Chancellor Michael Tee and Dean Patricia Arinto giving their support.

COURTESY: Kevin Roque, UPS-MCO via University of the Philippines/Facebook
